title: Adjudication record v1 — residual disagreement after the third labeler
description: Written by the seat or a human when, after the third labeler (third model family) has labeled the case, at least one critical field still has no majority (freeze PHASE0_FREEZE_2026-10-11.md section 7). One record per disagreeing field. No confidence, probability or score field exists anywhere in this schema.

values.description: The three labelers' values for this field, in draft order (family one, family two, third family). Each keeps its own span or typed absence.

ruling.description: first/second/third = the adjudicator adopts that labeler's value; none_of_the_above = the adjudicator rules a different value (recorded in resolved_value); unresolvable_defer = the source cannot decide the field (the case is deferred, never relabeled silently).

resolved_value.description: The adopted value with its span or typed absence. For ruling first/second/third this repeats that labeler's entry verbatim.

adjudicator.description: Seat id or human adjudicator id. Never a model confidence proxy; the adjudicator owns the ruling.
